description: Classifies each Kenya signed-bundle domain by how it reaches 9-country parity. 'universal' content is country-agnostic (physiology, pharmacology, scores, WHO standards) and reaches parity by promoting the WHO/Kenya baseline so every country inherits it. 'national-divergent' content varies by national guideline/formulary and needs a per-country overlay. 'mixed' is largely universal with a national slice (e.g. a condition's presentation is universal but first-line drug choice is national). This turns 'parity' into a concrete, quantified plan.
